_comment: Copy to config.json (or set ARTEX_CONFIG to another path). This file only contains database and skill_dir; LLM and other settings come from environment variables or the in-app UI.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > this file's database. Two styles: (A) fill the fields below; (B) set database.dsn to a full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Style (B): delete the database object above and use a full DSN. When dsn is non-empty the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one subdirectory per skill, each containing SKILL.md). Priority: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR env > this field > default (skills/ next to the binary). Leave empty or delete to use the default. Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.
